# Polène Paris

> > Polène Paris is a luxury handbag and leather goods brand specializing in Italian calf leather bags with architectural designs and artisanal craftsmanship.

Polène offers signature collections including Numéro Un, Béri, Cyme, and Mokki, featuring textured and smooth Italian leather in various colorways. The brand also creates the Plèi upcycled collection, canvas bags, jewelry, and leather home décor pieces crafted in Italy and France.

## Key Topics

- Italian calf leather
- Numéro Un flagship collection
- Béri folded design bags
- Cyme sculptured totes
- Mokki architectural bags
- Numéro Dix canvas bags
- Plèi upcycled leather collection
- Textured leather finishes
- Crossbody bags
- Luxury handbags
- Artisanal craftsmanship
- DHL EXPRESS shipping
- Italian suede leather
- 24-carat gold-plated jewelry
- Leather home décor

- [Mokki Mini - Textured Ebony](https://eng.polene-paris.com/products/mokki-mini-textured-ebony): Mokki Mini crossbody with 36 leather pieces in textured ebony
